title: RIPDPI anonymous client field report
description: Version 1 contract for one opt-in, anonymous, aggregated client field report. A report covers one hour-aligned window and holds per-endpoint outcome buckets. It carries no IP address, device or user identifier, subscription token, hostname or sub-hour timestamp. The client suppresses every bucket with fewer than 5 attempts. scripts/validate-field-report.py adds one check the schema cannot express: each latency histogram sums to its bucket's attempts.
$comment: Canonical source: ripdpi-vpn-deploy/contract/client-field-report.schema.json. Keep the client vendored copy byte-identical. x-contract-version is the cross-repo drift pin.

start_utc.description: Window start in UTC, rounded down to the hour. Minutes and seconds are always zero.

app_version.description: Application version as major.minor only; patch and build numbers are omitted.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in upper case.

server_ref.description: Opaque endpoint id from the ripdpi bundle endpoints map. The pattern admits no dot or colon, so an IPv4 address, IPv6 address or hostname cannot pass.

failure_stage.description: Present if and only if outcome is failure.

attempts.description: Connection attempts in this bucket. The client suppresses buckets with fewer than 5 attempts.

latency_ms_histogram.description: Eight attempt counts aligned with the fixed upper bounds in x-latency-bounds-ms: <=50, <=100, <=250, <=500, <=1000, <=2500, <=5000 and +Inf milliseconds. The counts sum to attempts.
